# Draft Glossary

*Auto-generated from glossary-seeds.csv.*

## Auth Failure

A POS or commerce transaction that fails authorisation at the card network

**Source:** 2026-04-17 Bob Murphy

## Bronze

The rawest reliable layer in the lakehouse — type-safe but un-enriched CDC output

**Source:** 2026-04-17 Bob Murphy

## CDC

Change data capture — streaming source database mutations into the lakehouse

**Source:** 2026-04-17 Bob Murphy

## Close

Monthly close — the finance process of finalising the month's financial results and reporting

**Source:** 2026-04-18 Emma Ward

## Consumer

A team or service that reads a data product through its contract

**Source:** 2026-04-16 Data Council kickoff

## Contract Break

A change to a producer's data product that violates its published contract

**Source:** 2026-04-18 Platform Team

## Customer

A person or organisation that transacts with MeshCo

**Source:** 2026-04-16 Carol Singh

## Data Contract

A producer-consumer agreement about a data product's schema, semantics, freshness, and quality

**Source:** 2026-04-16 Data Council kickoff

## Data Product

A curated, owned, SLO-backed dataset exposed to consumers with a published contract

**Source:** 2026-04-16 Data Council kickoff

## Domain

A business-owned area that publishes one or more data products; MeshCo has five: customer, product, orders, inventory, fulfilment

**Source:** 2026-04-16 Data Council kickoff

## EOD

End of day — daily batch cut-off for captures, reconciliation, and ERP handoff

**Source:** 2026-04-17 Bob Murphy

## Gold

Business-facing, SLO-backed lakehouse layer — data products are served from gold

**Source:** 2026-04-17 Bob Murphy

## Lineage

The end-to-end path data takes from source systems through transforms to consumers; column-level when possible

**Source:** 2026-04-17 Bob Murphy

## Medallion

The bronze/silver/gold layering convention in the lakehouse

**Source:** 2026-04-17 Bob Murphy

## Order

A customer's purchase intent, typically one basket of products at one time

**Source:** 2026-04-16 Carol Singh

## Producer

A team that publishes a data product

**Source:** 2026-04-16 Data Council kickoff

## Product

An item in the MeshCo catalogue — SKU-level

**Source:** 2026-04-16 Carol Singh

## Shipment

A physical delivery of one or more order lines to a customer address

**Source:** 2026-04-16 Supply Chain

## Silver

Cleaned, deduplicated, joined lakehouse layer — the basis for gold models

**Source:** 2026-04-17 Bob Murphy

## SLO

Service level objective — quantified promise about freshness, quality, or availability of a data product

**Source:** 2026-04-16 Data Council kickoff
